name: WebMCP Eval & Build Guide
tagline: Scores how AI-ready a site is and writes the fix list a developer can build from
description: Point it at a URL and it scores the page's WebMCP readiness, then explains in plain language what is missing and why it matters. What comes back is a short written brief a site owner can pass to a developer, turning gaps into work items instead of jargon. Evaluation and writing only; the site is never touched.
author: fxopsAI
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
